title: Evaluating Model Capabilities After Benchmark Saturation
abstract: arXiv:2610.20667v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rapid advances in AI capabilities are causing benchmarks to saturate. Once several models approach perfect scores, a benchmark loses its power to differentiate between them, and with it its utility for informing AI safety cases and frontier policies. Yet benchmark items produce far more information than the scores we typically extract from them: a full transcript of how each model solved the task. We investigate whether these transcripts can be used to assess model capabilities even after benchmark scores have saturated. We simulate saturation retrospectively using historical benchmark and model releases, and test whether protocols that access only correctly solved transcripts from saturated benchmarks can predict capabilities measured on held-out, unsaturated items. translated_title: 基准测试饱和后的模型能力评估
translated_abstract: AI能力的快速进步正在导致基准测试趋于饱和。一旦多个模型接近满分，基准测试就失去了区分它们的能力，同时也失去了为AI安全论证和前沿政策提供参考的价值。然而，基准测试题目所产生的信息远比我们通常从中提取的分数丰富：那就是每个模型如何完成任务的完整解题过程记录。我们研究这些过程记录是否能在基准分数饱和之后仍用于评估模型能力。我们利用历史上的基准测试和模型发布数据回顾性地模拟了饱和过程，并测试仅访问饱和基准中成功解题记录的协议能否预测在保留的未饱和题目上测得的能力。我们评估了几种具有代表性的从模型过程记录中提取信息的当代方法：成对评判、单条记录绝对评分以及基于预测的方法。
tldr: 该论文提出利用模型在饱和基准测试中的完整解题过程记录（而非仅依赖分数），即使基准分数饱和后仍能有效评估和预测模型能力。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that model transcripts from saturated benchmarks can be used to assess and predict model capabilities even after benchmark scores have saturated.
